description: Fetches and deduplicates container logs using pattern fingerprinting to reduce token usage. Prefer this over get_k8s_logs when triaging crashes or noisy logs.

inputSchema.description: Request for fetching and deduplicating container logs.

container.description: Optional. Optional container name. If omitted, uses the first container in the pod.

namespace.description: Optional. Optional namespace of the pod. Defaults to "default" if omitted.

parent.description: Required. The cluster that owns the pod. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/clusters/{cluster}

pod.description: Required. The name of the pod.

tail.description: Optional. Optional number of tail lines to fetch before deduplication (default 500).

name: get_k8s_log_summary

Status.description: The `Status` type defines a logical error model that is suitable for different programming environments, including REST APIs and RPC APIs. It is used by [gRPC](https://github.com/grpc). Each `Status` message contains three pieces of data: error code, error message, and error details. You can find out more about this error model and how to work with it in the [API Design Guide](https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors).

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of google.rpc.Code.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is a common set of message types for APIs to use.

additionalProperties.description: Properties of the object. Contains field @type with type URL.

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the google.rpc.Status.details field, or localized by the client.

outputSchema.description: Response containing deduplicated log patterns in JSON format.

errors.description: Errors encountered during log retrieval and summarization.

result.description: JSON string representing the deduplicated log summary.
